collection_summary.official_coordinate_records_note: Multiple FCC records can describe one physical site; counts are evidence records, not site counts.

proposed_benchmark.rule: As of 2026-08-25, include one physical site per <=500 m evidence cluster when it has a valid coordinate and supported Ka- or E-band gateway evidence in classes A-D; include current, historical, and planned sites for qualification geometry; exclude TT&C-only records, reported-not-verified/unconfirmed records, withdrawn-or-superseded-only filings, and records without a supportable specific coordinate.
